designationHistory.name: Sibley Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established it as the Sibley Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8167 on June 12, 1939, and it was renamed Sibley Lake National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS limited-interest refuges CCP, Table 4) and Pass B (American Presidency Project text and National Archives Executive Orders Disposition Table, 4 FR 2410) agree on order number and date. The refuge is a limited-interest (easement) refuge on private land. Renamed by Proclamation 2416 of July 25, 1940. The FWS Realty ServCat record labels the order 8166; the order text, the National Archives table and the CCP all give 8167 (8166 is Shell Lake), so 8167 is used.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1939
